summary: Frontend-only test of Stage 1 mobile responsiveness (390x844), plus a quick tablet check (768x1024) and a desktop regression check (1920x800). Every requested item passed and there were no page errors. Mobile: the top bar is visible, the sidebar starts off-screen (x=-288) and slides in to x=0 with an overlay, and the close button, an overlay tap and nav-pacjenci each close it (nav-pacjenci also goes to /patients). Horizontal width (scrollWidth) is 390 on Dashboard, /patients, patient detail and inside modals. Dashboard: month navigation, Dziś and the prev/next arrows work; the 7-column grid fits (cells ~47.7px); weekday names are 2-letter; cells show dots on mobile. Patients: cards are shown and there is no <table>; the Filtry toggle shows and hides all 6 filters; search narrows the list (1 card for a name, 0 for nonsense text); status badge -> dropdown -> Konsultacja showed the toast and the new label, then I reverted it to Zaplanowany (API check: status=planned, surgery_date unchanged); tapping a card opens /patients/{id}. Patient detail is one column; the edit modal sits at 16-374px with every grid in 1 column, and close-modal works. SurgeryConfirmModal (16 records) fits and dismiss closes it. Desktop: top bar hidden; sidebar sticky at x=0 and 256px wide, toggles to 80px and back; table rendered and patients-mobile-list not in the DOM; all 7 filter controls in one row (same y); no Filtry button; status change in a table row works (and was reverted); full weekday names; GlobalSearch trigger sits inside main and is not fixed.

issues: status-filter-button and procedure-filter-button are content-width (~208px), while location/asap/sort controls are full width. The column looks uneven; consider w-full on those two buttons below lg.

The 3-column layout (info / visits / history) is used at md, so each column is very narrow (~210-240px). Text wraps heavily ('Brak zarejestrowanych wizyt', 'Historia zmian'). Consider a single column or 2 columns until lg.
'Data urodzenia' uses the browser's native date input (existed before this change, not a regression).

action_items: Optional: make the status and procedure filter buttons full width in the mobile Filtry panel
Optional: improve the PatientDetail layout at 768-1023px (avoid 3 narrow columns)
critical_code_review_comments: PatientsList.jsx is 647 lines and growing. Consider moving the mobile card list and the table into separate components.

Dashboard calendar only renders data.upcoming_surgeries, so past days never show names or dots. The env currently has 0 upcoming surgeries, so the desktop 'names in cells' check was confirmed by code review (names are max-md:hidden, dots are md:hidden) rather than with live data.
useIsDesktop reads window.matchMedia synchronously in the initial state. Fine for CRA (no SSR).
seed_data_creation: None. Patient 27aead79 (Ankieta Anna) was switched planned->consultation->planned in both mobile and desktop tests; the final state is planned with surgery_date 2026-10-01 kept.

SurgeryConfirmModal shows after every login in this env (16 past surgeries); close it with surgery-confirm-dismiss. Breakpoint is lg = 1024px (useIsDesktop).
